```{r}
x <- c(1:7,NA)
x1 <- ifelse(is.na(x),1,0)
x1

y <- c(1.29, 2.35, 2.95, 3.77, 5.30, 5.09, 4, 4.5)
cbind(x,y)


# IMpute
x[is.na(x)] <- sum(1  +2  +3  +4  +5  +6  +7)/8

x

# fit regression 

m1 <- lm(y ~ x + x1)
summary(m1)
plot(m1)
m1$fitted.values
m1$residuals




plot(x,y)
abline(x,y)
```
